# Apply profile (`profile.apply`)

**Kind:** action · **Category:** Flow · **Runs as:** the signed-in user · **Revertible:** no

Applies a profile. The settings it changes are remembered and restored when the profile is reverted, automatically or with profile.revert.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `profile` | text | yes |  | Id of the profile to apply. Supports [placeholders](../placeholders.md). |
| `revert_on` | one of: `auto`, `app_unfocused`, `app_closed`, `logoff`, `lock`, `never` | no | `auto` | When to undo the profile automatically. 'auto' pairs it with the trigger: app_focused → app_unfocused, app_started → app_closed, logon → logoff, unlock → lock; other triggers never revert automatically. |
| `continue_on_error` | true / false | no | `false` | Keep running the next actions even if this one fails. |

## Example

```yaml
actions:
  - type: profile.apply
    profile: gaming
    revert_on: auto
```

## Notes

When the automatic revert is tied to an app (app_unfocused, app_closed) it waits for the same app that triggered the automation. If several active profiles change the same setting, the one with the highest priority wins; when it is reverted, the next one's value is applied, and the original value comes back only when no profile changes that setting any more.
